title: The 6 best to do list apps for Windows in 2026
summary: There are lots of great Windows to do list apps out there, if you know where to look. We tried out as many as we could get our hands on and outlined the best options here.
body_markdown:

Microsoft To Do


An all-around winner


Plan daily tasks with "My Day" view; Collaborate with others


Free


Todoist


Cross-platform syncing


Great organization features


Free for up to 5 active projects; $5/month for Pro plan


Singularity


Keeping everything in one place


Printable paper planning


$3.99/month or $40/year


TickTick


Blending simplicity with power


Desktop widgets; integrations with calendars


Free with limitations; $4.99/month for full functionality


Workflow


No-frills experience


Focus on helping you spend less time on organization


Free with limitations; $6.99/month to unlock all features


Super Productivity


Private, open-source to-do app


Powerful time-tracking features and a versatile user interface


Free
